title: PredictRequest
description: Request sent by fraud-detection-service to fraud-ml-service (POST /v1/predict). Contract version 1.0.

schema_version.description: Contract version the caller is using.

txn_id.description: Unique transaction identifier. Echoed in the response. Scoring is idempotent per txn_id.

timestamp.description: When the transaction was initiated (RFC 3339, UTC recommended).

type.description: Transaction type. v1 model scores TRANSFER and CASH_OUT only; other types return scored_by_model=false.

amount.description: Transaction amount in the given currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Accepted for forward compatibility; v1 model does not use it.

channel.description: Originating channel. Accepted for forward compatibility; v1 model does not use it.

sender_balance_before.description: Sender balance before the transaction. Accepted but IGNORED by the v1 model (see ADR-0005).

receiver_balance_before.description: Receiver balance before the transaction. Accepted but IGNORED by the v1 model (see ADR-0005).

metadata.description: Free-form extension point. Ignored by the v1 model. Do not rely on it for required data.

Context.description: History features computed by the caller using hour-bucketed windows (ADR-0006). All counts exclude the current transaction. Exact definitions: fraud-ml-service/docs/02-feature-spec.md.

sender_txn_count_1h.description: Sender's earlier transactions in the current hour bucket.

sender_txn_count_24h.description: Sender's earlier transactions in the current and previous 23 hour buckets.

sender_amount_sum_24h.description: Sum of amounts of those 24h transactions.

sender_unique_receivers_24h.description: Distinct receivers the sender paid in the 24h window.

sender_avg_amount_30d.description: Mean amount of the sender's earlier transactions over the 30d window (720 hour buckets). null if there are none.

is_new_receiver.description: True if the sender has no earlier transaction to this receiver within the 30d window.

receiver_incoming_count_24h.description: Earlier incoming transactions to the receiver (from any sender) in the 24h window.

receiver_unique_senders_24h.description: Distinct senders that paid the receiver in the 24h window.
